description: Before spending credits, call quote_generation and explain the returned price or unknown total. For a known quote, obtain approval and pass max_credits. For an unknown total, obtain explicit acceptance and pass accept_unknown_cost:true without max_credits. Never switch consent modes or remove or raise a ceiling without new user approval. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Generated songs may return preparing with a numeric music_id and retry_after_seconds instead of a task_id. Retry with that music_id and unchanged approved parameters; no paid video starts before readiness. Use this for music video generation: the user wants a music video (MV) for a song. Freebeat's music video agent plans scenes and generates and edits a multi-scene video timed to the song; people or characters from optional photos can appear. Requires music_id from upload_audio or a completed generate_music result; optional photos via upload_image. Starts a generation job that uses the user's existing Freebeat credits and usually takes 15–60 minutes; by default it uses the first 15 seconds of the song, or up to the song's end if shorter. Returns task_id and session_url; poll get_task_status every few minutes, call get_task_result after completed; on action_required relay the message and session_url. Do not use for dance videos, lyric videos, short singing-photo clips, lip-sync of an existing clip, standalone video clips without a song, or generating audio.

accept_unknown_cost.description: Set true only after the user explicitly accepts an unknown total, without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; this does not enforce a total budget.

end_ms.description: End of the song window in milliseconds. Defaults to start_ms + 15000, capped at the song end. The selected window must fit the song and the account limits.

image_urls.description: Optional reference photo URLs from upload_image.

max_credits.description: User-approved ceiling for a known current quote. Cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run. Never remove or raise it without new user consent.

music_id.description: An analyzed music_id from upload_audio, or result.music_id from a completed generate_music task. Generated songs are prepared automatically. On preparing, reuse the returned numeric music_id in the same tool after retry_after_seconds; no paid video has started.

prompt.description: The user's creative direction in their own words. Leave empty to let the agent decide.

remove_watermark.description: Remove the Freebeat watermark if the account allows it.

start_ms.description: Start of the song window in milliseconds. Defaults to 0.

name: generate_music_video

music_id.description: Prepared audio asset to reuse on a preparing response.

session_url.description: The freebeat.ai page where the user can watch, review, or continue this session.

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

task_id.description: The scoped task ID for get_task_status and get_task_result.
